name: Slot Game — UX Contract
description: 5 reels x 3 rows, 10 fixed paylines, base game only (per the spec: 'Main game only / Separate screen features: no'). The only interactive control is Spin; the Win field reports the last win. Reels stop left-to-right.

layout.title: top
layout.hud: below-reels (BALANCE | BET | WIN on one plate)
layout.responsive: contain-fit to any aspect ratio, rebuilt on resize

controls.label: Win
controls.note: Shows the last spin's win; counts up kinetically on a win.

controls.label: Bet (10 lines)
controls.note: Fixed total bet across the 10 lines; the brief specifies a Spin-only UI.

states.name: idle
states.description: Reels at rest showing the last grid; Spin enabled.

states.name: spinning
states.description: Reels in motion; Spin disabled; reels stop left -> right on a stagger.

states.name: resolving
states.description: Grid evaluated against the 10 paylines (Model decided the outcome before the animation).

states.name: win_presentation
states.description: Winning paylines drawn and cycled, winning symbols pulse, win amount counts up.

interactions.description: From idle: bet is deducted (Model.play decides the result), then the View plays the spin and any win.
Keyboard convenience for Spin (the only on-screen button is Spin).

accessibility.winFieldReadout: Win amount shown numerically and counted up
accessibility.missingArtFallback: Symbol cells fall back to a text label if a sprite frame is absent
